auth.label: Access Key
auth.description: Gainsight NXT REST API Access Key sent in the Accesskey header. Generate it from Administration > Connectors 2.0 > Create Connection > Gainsight API > Access_Key: https://support.gainsight.com/gainsight_nxt/Connectors/API_Integrations/Generate_REST_API_Key.

extraFields.label: API Base URL
extraFields.description: Your Gainsight NXT tenant or custom API domain used in Company API endpoint URLs, such as https://companyapi.gainsightcloud.com or https://companyapi.yourcompany.com.

actions.name: delete_company
actions.description: Delete one Gainsight NXT Company record by its GSID.

gsid.description: The Gainsight GSID of the Company record to delete.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for deleting a Gainsight Company.

result.description: Whether Gainsight reported a successful request.

rawResponse.description: The raw Gainsight API response wrapper, including result, errorCode, errorDesc, requestId, data, and message when returned.

outputSchema.description: Normalized response for a Gainsight Company delete request.

actions.name: insert_companies
actions.description: Insert up to 50 records into the Gainsight NXT Company object using field names from your tenant's Data Management schema.

items.description: A Gainsight object record keyed by field names from your tenant's Data Management schema.

records.description: Company records to insert. Each record must use field names from your Gainsight Company schema.

lookups.description: Optional Gainsight import lookup configuration used to populate GSID fields from the same or another object.

inputSchema.description: Request body for inserting one or more Gainsight Company records.

result.description: Whether Gainsight reported a successful request.

anyOf.description: Number of records Gainsight reported for the mutation.

count.description: Number of records Gainsight reported for the mutation.

items.description: A Gainsight object record keyed by field names from your tenant's Data Management schema.

records.description: Gainsight records returned by the Company API.

errors.description: Raw Gainsight validation or processing errors returned for failed records.

rawResponse.description: The raw Gainsight API response wrapper, including result, errorCode, errorDesc, requestId, data, and message when returned.

outputSchema.description: Normalized response for a Gainsight Company mutation request.

actions.name: query_companies
actions.description: Query Gainsight NXT Company records with selected fields, optional where conditions, sorting, limit, and offset.

items.description: A Company field name or relationship field path to return.

select.description: Company fields to return, including relationship paths such as csm__gr.email when supported by your tenant schema.

name.description: Company field name used by this condition.

alias.description: Condition alias used in the where expression.

operator.description: Gainsight query operator such as EQ, IN, BTW, GT, or LT.

value.description: Condition value or values accepted by the Gainsight operator.

items.description: A Gainsight query condition. Include the documented fields such as name, alias, operator, and value.

conditions.description: Conditions used by the Gainsight where expression.

expression.description: Boolean expression over condition aliases, such as A OR B.

additionalProperties.description: Sort direction for a Company field.

orderBy.description: Optional sort map whose keys are Company fields and whose values are asc or desc.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Gainsight documents a maximum of 5000.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for fetching additional records.

inputSchema.description: Request body for querying Gainsight Company records.

result.description: Whether Gainsight reported a successful request.

items.description: A Gainsight object record keyed by field names from your tenant's Data Management schema.

records.description: Gainsight records returned by the Company API.

rawResponse.description: The raw Gainsight API response wrapper, including result, errorCode, errorDesc, requestId, data, and message when returned.

outputSchema.description: Normalized response for a Gainsight Company query request.

actions.name: update_companies
actions.description: Update up to 50 Gainsight NXT Company records identified by one to three Company key fields.

items.description: A Company field name used as an update key.

keys.description: Company field names used to identify records. Gainsight supports up to three String, GSID, Number, or Email keys and combines them with AND.

items.description: A Gainsight object record keyed by field names from your tenant's Data Management schema.

records.description: Company records to update. Each record must contain the key fields and the values to update.

lookups.description: Optional Gainsight import lookup configuration used to populate GSID fields from the same or another object.

inputSchema.description: Request body for updating one or more Gainsight Company records.

result.description: Whether Gainsight reported a successful request.

anyOf.description: Number of records Gainsight reported for the mutation.

count.description: Number of records Gainsight reported for the mutation.

items.description: A Gainsight object record keyed by field names from your tenant's Data Management schema.

records.description: Gainsight records returned by the Company API.

errors.description: Raw Gainsight validation or processing errors returned for failed records.

rawResponse.description: The raw Gainsight API response wrapper, including result, errorCode, errorDesc, requestId, data, and message when returned.

outputSchema.description: Normalized response for a Gainsight Company mutation request.
